title: PSX Character Library v1.11: Showa Dusk added
bodyHtml:
Showa Dusk is in the Library: 14 adult townsfolk of a Japanese country town after dark, from the salaryman and the night shift nurse to the faceless man, the masked woman and the drowned woman, 42 skinned entities, rigged on the same skeleton with the same 45 clips as every other pack here. That makes 25 packs and 349 characters on this page.

If you own the Library, download again at no extra cost. Showa Dusk joins the Horror Casts archive beside Butcher's Night and Black Site (now 642 MB), so that is the only file you need. The other nine archives changed only in their root files (Readme, catalogue and manifest now list 25 packs); the packs inside them are the same bytes as before.

Changelog, v1.11.0:

  • Added Showa Dusk: 14 PSX Japanese Horror Townsfolk: Salaryman, Night shift nurse, Rice farmer, Office worker, Konbini night clerk, Village grandmother, Faceless man, Schoolteacher, Patrol officer, Delivery rider, School caretaker, Masked woman, Shrine caretaker, Drowned woman.
  • Horror Casts archive: now Butcher's Night, Black Site and Showa Dusk.
  • Readme, CATALOGUE and manifest updated to 25 packs and 349 characters.

Showa Dusk is also sold on its own page: https://csaf.itch.io/showa-dusk-psx-japanese-horror-townsfolk

How we tested it: every file in the ten archives was read back and checked against the build its own page serves (3869 files). One pack from each archive was extracted and run through our pack gate, and a blank Godot 4.7 project imported all 420 of their GLBs with no errors.

The price: $19.99 today. A rise to $24.99 for new buyers is announced for 7 December 2026 in its own post here; it goes ahead only if the Library has sold at least three times at its full price by that day, and any later change waits for the sales that follow. If you already own it, nothing changes for you.

Free first: one character from every one of these packs is free in the PSX Characters Sampler.

Count so far: 27 live PSX listings, 9 of them sold, 31 purchases in total.

For anything, post a comment on the page. If the Library helps your game, a quick rating is the best way to support the next pack.

Made with AI tools: the bodies were generated by scripts an AI system wrote, and every texture is an AI image model's painting projected onto the mesh. The skeleton and clips are the CC0 Quaternius Universal Animation Library.
